name: grip-attempt-gate-11a
status: Temporary Grip attempt Visual Gate (ACTION-11A). Shown only during Grip reach. Not Product art until User Play Test accepts it; the Grip success / grappled look is a separate, later Task.
note: One authored red Grip attempt pose is the only source. It is normalized like the accepted idle red (one whole-sprite rotation so FRONT = local +X, explicit root, body core = 2R, exact /4 downscale). Blue reuses the accepted red -> blue rule of runtime_wrestler_recipe.json (single owner): local-Y reflection ((x, y) -> (x, H - y)) + mawashi-only recolor. Grip attempt has no left/right hand semantics, so one red pose and its reflected blue are enough.

measurement.method: Same landmark registration as the Product Tsuppari / Counter poses (measure_tsuppari_pose.measure_landmarks / normalization, run once for this candidate): hair blob and mawashi centroids at 1/2 BOX scale registered to the accepted idle red master; rotation delta = angle(H -> B) - idle angle(H -> B); scale s = mean(sqrt(hair area ratio), sqrt(mawashi area ratio)); idle root / body core carried by s * Rot(delta) about the H/B midpoint; source_front_deg = idle 160.7 + delta. Recorded values rounded: front 0.1 deg, points 1 px.

measurement_evidence.candidate: ACTION-11A User-provided Grip attempt pose (both arms reaching forward with open hands).
measurement_evidence.note: Torso, head and mawashi are drawn at the idle scale and nearly the idle orientation (hair sqrt ratio 1.002, mawashi 1.008); only the arms differ.

mask_limits.note: Validation of the accepted hue-band + largest-component mawashi mask at runtime scale (fail closed). Same limits as idle / Tsuppari (no Grip-specific allowance).
